set.body: Child of bd-01M35JG7DXD7NSEE4WVEKT3CSF per T1. Scope approved by the lead on Fray #86 seq 749. Acceptance: ADR 0007 amendment (draft 96dd5345 on claude-p1/ac4-s1-sampled-frames); SampledFrameSet keeps presentation ordinal and sample index distinct, with exact byte accounting; CaptionSearch.join is generic over full and sampled sets, takes an expected edition, refuses unsampled ordinals, and closes each extent on its own samples; full FrameSet semantics unchanged; Draft authority. Named negative controls for membership, bytes, edition and extent coverage. Pure tests on F0. Starts after the 942a9f75 batch lands.
set.title: [media] AC4-S1: SampledFrameSet + expected-edition + unsampled-ordinal refusals (child of bd-01M35JG7DXD7NSEE4WVEKT3CSF)
